scope: D5.2: avoid unchanged Academy workbook writes
behavior: Compare learning content against the workbook already read by the existing save transaction, after checking the current cloud revision.
When content and its document envelope match, acknowledge the device draft without changing the cloud body, timestamps or revision.
Changed answers, rubric, sharing, safety or definition still persist. Definition changes retain atomic history archival.
A stale device revision still conflicts even when its content matches. Invalid cloud JSON remains an error.

validation.method: Actual service functions with atomic SDK and device-storage fixtures; browser and Rules regression coverage remains required in hosted CI.

release.requires: Release the preceding reviewed optimization stack, verify the exact source checks and unchanged integration tree, then publish this frontend-only follow-up.

limitations: The no-op path still performs the existing authoritative transaction read; transaction retries can repeat that read.
Observed request frequency and monetary savings have not been measured.
